geometric_contract.observer_field: future-directed unit timelike congruence uhat^a with g_ab uhat^a uhat^b=-1
geometric_contract.physical_path_measure: dell=-uhat_a dx^a for a future-directed null ray
geometric_contract.positivity: dell>0 for every future-directed null displacement measured by the declared congruence
geometric_contract.reparameterization_proof: For any orientation-preserving lambda'=f(lambda), dx^a=(dx^a/dlambda)dlambda=(dx^a/dlambda')dlambda'; therefore -uhat_a dx^a and every scalar integral F(x)dell are unchanged.
geometric_contract.congruence_boundary: dell is a scalar once uhat^a is declared but is not congruence-independent; changing physical observers changes locally measured photon frequency and path length. Earth tests must use one frozen Earth-centered observer congruence and astrophysical tests must state their source/lens/cosmological congruence.
geometric_contract.forbidden_measure: an unspecified affine ds or d-lambda integral with normalization-dependent value

state_family.common_causal_equation: c tau D_u psi_tau + psi_tau = S
state_family.common_initial_condition: psi_tau(t=0,x)=0 for every causal member and every fixture
state_family.nesting_statement: C08 is the a0=0, one-positive-tau-at-a-time constrained subfamily of C07; it is not a separate observable family on fixtures where C07 permits the same psi_tau.

structural_triage.label: DETERMINISTIC_STRUCTURAL_PREFLIGHT_NOT_DATA_OR_MODEL_SCORE
structural_triage.fixture_metric: number of fixture families with at least one output different from C00 at unit probe couplings
structural_triage.sort_rule: descending(sum(binary_metrics)+fixture_metric-penalty_count), then closure_id; ties share a tier
structural_triage.claim_boundary: triage ranks engineering readiness for the next falsifier, not truth, evidence, novelty, or goodness of fit

source_units: two lowest-eccentricity eligible Galileo PRNs selected from SP3 geometry before any CLK rows are opened
galileo_frozen_analysis.epoch_grid: exact intersection of CLK epochs with SP3 epochs; no interpolation; exclude first and last common epoch of each daily file
galileo_frozen_analysis.response: first finite difference of satellite clock offset divided by exact epoch separation, computed only after source and response receipts
galileo_frozen_analysis.instantaneous_template: weak-field Earth monopole potential plus special-relativistic v^2/(2c^2), with sign and any already-applied product correction resolved from the pinned format/technical note before opening CLK rows
galileo_frozen_analysis.memory_template: causal exponential convolution of the registered instantaneous source template minus the instantaneous template; initialize each PRN from the unique periodic fixed point obtained source-only from its first complete SP3 orbital cycle, then propagate continuously across all seven days with no daily reset
nuisance_design: per-PRN per-day intercept and linear drift in fractional-frequency response
SP3 orbit-error proxy if supplied by product metadata
solar-radiation-pressure/orbital systematic templates only if frozen from source-only metadata before CLK access
no temperature or magnetic proxy imputation when unavailable
circular-control PRN indicators with shared processing terms
galileo_frozen_analysis.likelihood: Gaussian generalized least squares with one AR(1) coefficient and innovation variance estimated on E14 development days only for each frozen tau; seven leave-one-day-out folds, each fitting nuisance and beta on six E14 days and accumulating predictive log likelihood on the omitted seventh E14 day; tau selected once by the seven-fold E14 total; all coefficients including beta and tau then frozen for E18 and circular controls
galileo_frozen_analysis.primary_statistic: E18 minus-null predictive log-likelihood difference for the frozen E14-selected causal-memory model
required_sign_checks: E14 development beta has one sign in at least six of seven leave-one-day fits
E18 holdout beta-free prediction improves over null without amplitude or tau refit
neither selected circular control shows an equal-or-larger standardized causal quadrature
phase-scrambled source histories do not match or exceed the real registered source history
galileo_frozen_analysis.chromatic_control: CLK products are ionosphere-free combinations and cannot alone establish chromaticity; a future raw multi-frequency RINEX lane must compare E1/E5a/E5b with plasma TEC controls
galileo_frozen_analysis.promotion_boundary: development falsifier only because the public manifest lacks onboard temperature/magnetic series and individual-clock identity; no discovery claim can pass on this source alone

decision_rules.equivalence: C00 and C01 are one observable family in the executed domain
decision_rules.nesting: C08 must be recorded as a constrained subfamily of C07, never as independently identifiable merely because it has a causal equation
decision_rules.finite_fixture: separation on the frozen fixtures is not a proof of global identifiability
decision_rules.gauge: C02 remains failed until a physical potential-zero field/boundary is derived
decision_rules.energy: same-sign cumulative losses remain conditional until field/medium energy-momentum accounting is derived
decision_rules.congruence: every path claim is conditional on a declared physical observer congruence
decision_rules.publication: only a bounded methods/theory claim is eligible; empirical gravity and historical novelty remain unestablished
